description:
## Question

Turnkey pins buck2-2026-04-15 (`toolchain.toml` sets `buck2-toolchain` version 3, resolved through the toolbox flake). Upstream work on test execution caching landed in Feb–Mar 2026, and further caching work continued after that. Establish exactly what this pinned binary supports, citing the buck2 source at the matching commit (the binary reports `2026-04-14-7600cb80…`):

1. Does `ExternalRunnerTestInfo` accept `supports_test_execution_caching`? Are stable test output paths the default (upstream d2b7ecb171 / 91c4d7d109)?
2. Does an executor with local execution on, remote off and remote cache on get cache lookups for tests? Are local test executions ever uploaded?
3. For ordinary `run` actions: `allow_cache_uploads`, the local `LocalActionCache`/dep-file reuse, and whether `buck2.sqlite_dep_file_state` (upstream 2ca2802708, 2026-07-31) is present.
4. Is the `[test] v2_test_executor` protocol (`test.proto`) at this commit identical to what quokka vendors? Note any differences.
5. How the toolbox flake builds buck2: from source or prebuilt? Could turnkey carry a buck2 patch, and what would a buck2 bump cost?

comments.text:
Resolution. Findings are in docs/research/buck2-pinned-test-caching.md on local jj bookmark research/buck2-pinned-caching (commit c3bcb214; workspace turnkey-research-buck2-pinned-caching).

The pin is facebook/buck2@7600cb80070a88b88be67aa5d20d6a93cffa0223 (tag 2026-04-15), a prebuilt release binary from toolbox.

- Tests can opt in with ExternalRunnerTestInfo(supports_test_execution_caching = True). Stable test output paths are the default (91c4d7d109).
- Lookups go ONLY to the RE action cache. They need: the target opted in, a runner that doesn't send disable_test_execution_caching, and an executor with remote_cache_enabled = True set explicitly (in OSS it defaults to remote_enabled) plus [buck2_re_client] addresses.
- Local test runs are never uploaded (orchestrator.rs L1302-1315, unchanged on main). So without RE workers, buck2 alone never produces a test cache hit.
- turnkey today uses prelude//platforms:default: local-only, no remote cache, so there are no lookups at all.
- Rust, Go, Python and C++ prelude test rules don't set the flag. Only Java, Android and Kotlin do.
- Build actions CAN upload local results when the executor has allow_cache_uploads plus remote cache, and the action allows upload (or buck2.default_allow_cache_upload). Only successful runs are uploaded.
- sqlite_dep_file_state is absent. It first ships in 2026-08-22.
- A runner sees hits as cache_hit: true / ACTION_CACHE.
- quokka's test.proto is byte-identical to the pinned one.
- Patching buck2 means a from-source build (nightly-2026-01-18, self-generated Cargo.lock) plus a new buck2-toolchain version through registryExtensions.
- Upgrading past the pin removes network_access from ExternalRunnerTestInfo.
- The turnkey prelude matches release 2026-03-15, not 2026-04-15. Bump them together.

title: What test-caching support does our pinned buck2 have?
